+ ud, open out.
paṭa, m. woven stuff; cloth; garment.

pāṭala, a. pale red; as m. Bignonia
suaveolens.

paṭu, a.
 —1. sharp; and so
 —2. fig.

pāṭali, f. Bignonia suaveolens or trumpetflower.
 [cf. pāṭala.]
